title: Glanmore Lake Walking Route

images.title: John Webster / Glanmore Lake
images.caption: Glanmore Lake measures about 1 km (0.6 mi) long north–south and 0.5 km (0.3 mi) wide. It lies about 28 km (17 mi) southwest of Kenmare, near the village of Lauragh

images.title: Across Glanmore Lake by Gordon Hatton, CC BY-SA 2.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
images.caption: The lake drains into the Croansaght River, which in turn flows to Kenmare Bay. The lake is a salmon and sea trout fishing destination

description: This walk visits Glanmore Lake on the Beara Peninsula in County Kerry. On the eastern side of the lake there's a quiet country lane where you can enjoy an easy walk or cycle. It's a very peaceful place with fine views across the water to the surrounding mountains.For an elevated view of the lake head up to theHealy Pass Waterfall. It's located just east of the lake and includes a small parking area where you can enjoy an excellent view down to the lake.
